description: Hydrodynamics scope decision: which particle-SPH, incompressible-SPH, entropy-SPH, Eulerian grid, and hybrid schemes are product requirements, with equations, state ownership, integrator coupling, conservation targets, supported boundaries, and explicit rejections.
phase_premise: The issue series P8-SPH-*, P8-EULER-*, P8-HYBRID-*, and P8-QUAL-* carry an id token that collides with the frozen phase P8 (mpi-kdk-overlap-and-migration). This decision maps the hydrodynamics family to the contiguous phase P10; new hydrodynamics ids, test ids, and quality phases use P10 only.
gravity_only_preserved: The gravity-only path (fixed-kdk-v1 and comoving-kdk-v2, all solver families, PBC, MPI, restart, reduction diagnostics) is unchanged by this decision; hydrodynamics add a force/energy contribution, never a replacement.

wcsp-v1.name: weakly-compressible SPH

equations.kernel: cubic B-spline W(r, h) with compact support 2h, normalized by the deterministic summation; h is the per-particle smoothing length
equations.density: rho_i = sum_j m_j W(r_ij, h) over the deterministic local-neighbor index contract
equations.eos: Tait: P = (rho_0 c_s^2 / gamma) * ((rho / rho_0)^gamma - 1), gamma = 7, rho_0 rest density, c_s reference sound speed
equations.momentum: dv_i/dt = -(1/rho_i) sum_j m_j (P_i / rho_i^2 + P_j / rho_j^2 + viscosity_ij) grad_i W_ij, with a documented linear-plus-quadratic artificial viscosity
equations.energy: du_i/dt = (1/2) sum_j m_j (P_i / rho_i^2 + P_j / rho_j^2 + viscosity_ij) (v_i - v_j) . grad_i W_ij

wcsp-v1.state_ownership: per-particle density, pressure, specific internal energy, and smoothing length are SoA hydro execution state owned by the hydro layer; particles keep the existing SoA mass, position, and velocity boundaries
wcsp-v1.integrator_coupling: the hydro momentum contribution is evaluated through the SolverForceEvaluation boundary in the existing fixed-step split; no variable timestep (the CFL condition is a documented step-selection constraint on the fixed step)
conservation_targets: total mass is exactly conserved by the density summation over the retained mask
non-dissipative entropy tendency zero apart from the explicit viscosity switch
internal-plus-kinetic energy bounded over periodic zero-gravity runs
second-order convergence of a smooth periodic density field
oracles: uniform rest-lattice density reproduces analytic rho_0 to the symmetric-kernel tolerance
hydrostatic equilibrium profile against the analytic integrated pressure gradient
periodic 1D shock-tube (Sod) against the reference profile
wcsp-v1.boundaries: periodic boundaries via the existing PBC contract; the hydro layer stays domain-agnostic like the integrator

isph-v1.name: incompressible SPH projection method

equations.projection: pressure Poisson solve on the deterministic neighbor graph: div(v*/dt) = laplacian(P)/rho, with the retained solver reusing the deterministic linear machinery
equations.correction: v^{n+1} = v* - (dt / rho) grad P so the projected divergence is zero to the solver tolerance

isph-v1.state_ownership: pressure becomes a Lagrange field of the projection; density is fixed at rho_0; no internal energy advection in the retained minimal mode
isph-v1.integrator_coupling: the projected correction enters the drift of the existing fixed-step split; the comoving frame keeps the canonical-momentum kick, only the pressure term differs
conservation_targets: volume conservation (zero projected divergence) to the linear-solve tolerance
total momentum conservation in periodic zero-gravity lanes
isph-v1.boundaries: periodic via the existing PBC contract

ysph-v1.name: entropy-formulation SPH variant
ysph-v1.definition_required: P8-SPH-007 must freeze an unambiguous clean-room definition and equations before any implementation; no imported scheme is acceptable. The retained formulation is the entropy form P_i = A_i rho_i^gamma with per-particle specific entropy A_i replacing internal energy, viscosity kept as the documented dissipative switch
ysph-v1.integrator_coupling: same as wcsp-v1; A_i advects in the energy slot of the split step

eulerian-godunov-v1.name: Eulerian Godunov finite-volume method
eulerian-godunov-v1.coordinates: static Eulerian grid in the physical or comoving frame

equations.state: conservative cell state Q = (rho, rho v, E) on the P5 grid contract (indexing, boundaries, precision)
equations.flux: Godunov: Q^{n+1} = Q^n - (dt / volume) sum_faces F_f, with face fluxes from the selected Riemann solver
equations.reconstruction: deterministic slope reconstruction with the chosen limiter; the CFL constraint selects the fixed step

eulerian-godunov-v1.state_ownership: the grid owns the Eulerian field state; particles enter only through the hybrid coupling, never as a second Eulerian copy
eulerian-godunov-v1.integrator_coupling: the grid advance is a separate deterministic stage; gravity fields are interpolated from the existing solver path under the P5 deterministic interpolation contract
conservation_targets: drive-space conservation: sum(rho), sum(rho v), sum(E) change only by boundary fluxes
shock-tube and Riemann-family oracles against the analytic reference
eulerian-godunov-v1.boundaries: periodic via the existing PBC contract on the grid mesh

hybrid-sph-grid-v1.name: SPH and Eulerian grid coupling
hybrid-sph-grid-v1.equations: P8-HYBRID-001 freezes the coupling region, the two-way momentum and energy exchange, and the deterministic double-counting prevention
hybrid-sph-grid-v1.state_ownership: each particle and cell keeps a single host; the coupling layer owns only the exchange descriptors
conservation_targets: no double counting of mass, momentum, or energy across the coupling region
identical free-stream trajectories on both sides of the coupling boundary

rejected.imported_hydrodynamics_implementations: reject: clean-room forbids an imported implementation; every scheme is defined by this contract and its issue refinements only
rejected.zero_distance_softening_as_collision: reject: overlapping with PHYS-001 non-goal; Plummer softening is never a physical contact or merger model
rejected.variable_timestep_hydro: reject: consistent with plan/integration.json, no production variable timestep exists; CFL is a step-selection constraint on the fixed step
rejected.sph_as_gravity_solver: reject: SPH densities never replace the gravitational force path; hydro adds force, gravity stays on the existing solver matrix

interface_rules: the particle-based hydro phases (wcsp, isph, ysph) evaluate through the existing SolverForceEvaluation boundary; no new solver entry point
the comoving integrator (INT-005) is the default hydro frame; the canonical-momentum kick is unchanged, hydro terms enter the same fixed-step split
checkpoint capture, rollback, finite-state validation, and no-hot-path-allocation rules match the KDK/comoving integrators
gravity-only trajectories and all pre-existing test ids are unchanged
new hydrodynamics tests and quality phases use the P10 phase with TST-P10-* ids
